# Apoptosis and cell cycle (fabricated claims)

Gene expression profiling in the apoptosis and cell cycle pathway analysis revealed significant perturbations. BCL2 was strongly upregulated in the treated cells (Table 3). BAX was downregulated relative to the control arm (Table 3). CASP3 was elevated with an effect size of 4.1 (Table 3).

TP53 expression was decreased in this context (Table 3). CDKN1A was downregulated, suggesting reduced cell cycle arrest (Table 3). MDM2 showed strong induction (Table 3). MYC was upregulated with log2FC 2.5 (Table 3).

CCND1 was upregulated (Table 3). EGFR was downregulated in the treated arm (Table 3). KRAS was elevated (Table 3).
